title: ScentYou — Premium Perfume Store
shortDesc: Full-featured e-commerce store for a premium perfume brand. Features product listings, loyalty rewards, discount flows, and a clean conversion-focused layout.
fullDesc: Built for ScentYou.pk — a growing Pakistani perfume brand. Includes product catalog with filtering, promotional banners, loyalty programme integration, and mobile-optimized shopping experience designed for high conversion rates.

title: FurnitureHub — Home Furniture Marketplace
shortDesc: Comprehensive furniture marketplace with category browsing, same-day delivery promotions, and interior design consultation flows.
fullDesc: A large-scale furniture e-commerce platform for FurnitureHub.pk. Features rich category pages, promotional sliders, interior & architectural consultancy sections, and smooth product discovery UX optimized for desktop and mobile.

title: MySmallRecipes — Food & Recipe Blog
shortDesc: Clean, content-focused recipe blog with category navigation, food photography layouts, and reader-friendly article structure.
fullDesc: Developed for MySmallRecipes.com — a recipe and food inspiration blog. Features article-first design with clear category navigation (Pasta, Bread, Vegan, Salad, etc.), food photography showcases, and fast-loading pages for optimal reader experience.

title: Dr. Hamza Dental Centre — Medical Website
shortDesc: Premium medical website for a microscopic restorative dentist. Features appointment booking, service showcase, and a luxury clinical aesthetic.
fullDesc: Designed and developed for Dr. Hamza Dental Centre. A high-end medical website with elegant gold and neutral tones, full-screen hero with doctor profile, treatment listings, appointment booking CTA, and trust-building contact flows.

title: High-Impact YouTube Thumbnails
shortDesc: Custom thumbnail compositions crafted with bold visual hierarchy, contrast lighting, and color psychology.
fullDesc: A curated collection of click-worthy YouTube thumbnails designed to boost impressions and view velocity. Built using Photoshop with hand-tuned subject cutouts, dynamic typography hooks, and high-impact color grading.

title: Cinematic Video Editing & Post-Production
shortDesc: Paced video storytelling with tight audio design, dynamic jump cuts, motion graphics, and rich color grades.
fullDesc: Full post-production suite for short-form and long-form video content. Features seamless b-roll pacing, sound effects, subtitles, and color correction optimized for viewer retention on YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.
